pages.text: Quartz Enriched Iron is an enhanced material that combines the processing capabilities of Quartz with the structural stability of Iron. This material is crucial for crafting components that require durability and reliable performance under heavy loads.

Properties:$(li)Enhanced structural stability$(li)Improved durability and longevity$(li)Better resistance to wear and tear$(br2)This material is particularly useful in crafting components that need to handle continuous operation and heavy workloads.

Uses:$(li)Storage Blocks$(li)Controllers$(li)Network Receivers$(li)Processing Units$(br2)The enhanced stability makes it ideal for components that need to maintain consistent performance under heavy usage.
